description.narrative:
Stödja kommuner i Albaniens resultatuppföljning och lokalt deltagande.
Det övergripande målet är att förbättra styrningen och serviceleveransen på kommunal nivå till förmån för albanska medborgare, i enlighet med överenskomna lägsta och överkomliga standarder för ett hållbart landsystem.

Supporting municipalities of Albania's performance monitoring and local participation.
The overall goal is to improve governance and service delivery at the municipal level in benefit of Albanian citizens, in accordance with agreed minimum and affordable standards for a sustainable country system.

The overall goal of BtF2 is to improve governance and service delivery at the municipal level in benefit of Albanian citizens, in accordance with agreed minimum and affordable standards for a sustainable country system. The project envisions realizing its goal by working to achieve three outcomes namely: (i) Municipal administrations improve service delivery (waste management & preschool) towards more appropriate and affordable standards. The project will work towards the achievement of this outcome by facilitating implementation of national service standards, offering technical assistance to municipalities that are implementing the different measures, and by supporting public participation/consultation on service delivery. The impact of project outputs is monitored and assessed by reviewing a wide range of reports, protocols, participant lists, model applications, capacity building offers, and content produced by a wide range of actors such as the municipalities, Ministries, and media.
(ii) Municipal councils oversee adequately the performance of municipal administrations and engage in evidence-based decision-making. This will be achieved by on the one hand offering Councillors technical support and capacity building to support them in fulfilling their mandate and secondly, by employing project activities designed to establish effective communication channels between citizens and councillors and to support relevant system actors in policy development and knowledge sharing with municipal councils.
(iii) Having a new municipal performance management system and a performance-based grant in place. This activity revolves around two pillars: firstly, its about supporting (technical/capacity building) and facilitating relevant actors (stakeholders) in designing and implementing a performance management system and subsequently to support the monitoring and assessment of performance reports generated therein. The second pillar revolves around the creation and implementation of a performance-based grant scheme (PBGS), whereby the project will facilitate multi-stakeholder discussions on the design of the PBGS as well as supporting the implementation and monitoring of the grant scheme by means of technical assistance.
